user.title: Set up Notify Switchboard
user.description: Notify Switchboard is a proxy: it never delivers a notification itself. Once it is set up, build the routing table from its options: people and their notify services first, then one target per alert.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notify Switchboard is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Notify Switchboard
init.description: Add the people this house notifies, then one target per alert. Each target becomes a notify.switchboard_[slug] service you can list under an alert's notifiers.

person.title: Person
person.description: Which notify services reach this person, and when they are silent.

data_description.entity_id: The person.* entity whose presence decides whether this person is notified.
data_description.outputs: Notify service names without the notify. prefix, for example mobile_app_alice. A service that does not exist yet is tolerated and retried.
data_description.silence_entities: Any entity whose state on means silent: a schedule, an input_boolean, a binary sensor.
data_description.wake_time: End of the night silence. A message dropped while silent is delivered then instead of being lost.

data_description.entity_id: The person is also removed from every target's audience.

target.title: Target
target.description: One row of the routing table. It becomes notify.switchboard_[slug].

data_description.slug: Lowercase, no spaces. Renaming it breaks every alert that lists the old service.
data_description.name: Shown to people, and used as the message in observer mode when the alert carries none.
data_description.class: Free text used for grouping only, for example building or pets.
data_description.default_priority: Only critical bypasses a person's silence and snoozes.
data_description.alert_entity: The alert.* this row is tied to. Required for the Acknowledge button.
data_description.audience: The people considered for this target. Anyone else is not notified.
data_description.presence_rule: Whether the person's person.* state has to be home, away, or does not matter.
data_description.allow_acknowledge: Adds an Acknowledge button that turns the alert off.
data_description.snooze_minutes: Comma-separated minutes, for example 15, 60. Leave empty for no snooze button.
data_description.default_data: Merged under the caller's data; the caller wins on conflicting keys.
data_description.observer_mode: Watch the alert's state instead of waiting to be called as a notifier.
data_description.message: Optional template used in observer mode when the alert goes off. The alert's state is available as alert, for example {{ alert.attributes.level }}. Leave empty to send the name.
data_description.done_message: Optional template used in observer mode when the alert returns to idle. Leave empty to send the translated back-to-normal text.
data_description.default_title: Title used when the caller gives none, and for every message observer mode sends.

data_description.slug: The notify.switchboard_[slug] service disappears with it.

data_description.default_target: Used by notify.switchboard when no target is given, and by the notify entity.

error.duplicate_person: This person is already in the table.
error.no_outputs: Give at least one notify service.
error.recursive_output: An output cannot point back at Notify Switchboard.
error.invalid_output: A notify service name contains characters a service name cannot hold.
error.invalid_entity: This is not an entity id.
error.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
error.duplicate_slug: Another target already uses this slug.
error.invalid_priority: Pick one of info, normal, high, critical.
error.invalid_presence_rule: Pick one of always, home_only, away_only.
error.unknown_person: This target names somebody who is not in the table.
error.invalid_default_data: Default data must be an object.

abort.nothing_to_remove: There is nothing to remove yet.

unknown_target.title: Unknown Notify Switchboard target
unknown_target.description: Something called notify.switchboard with the target {slug}, which is not in the routing table. The message was dropped. Add the target, or fix the caller.

missing_output.title: Notify service unusable
missing_output.description: The notify service {output} has failed for several notifications in a row: it does not exist, or every call to it raised. Messages routed to it are lost. Fix the service, or remove it from the person's outputs.

invalid_service_target.title: A card or script keeps calling an unknown target
invalid_service_target.description: A notify_switchboard service has been refused several times for the target {value}, which is not in the routing table. Something — most likely a card or a script still pointing at a renamed row — keeps asking for it. Fix the caller, or add the target.

invalid_service_person.title: A card or script keeps naming an unusable person
invalid_service_person.description: A notify_switchboard service has been refused several times for {value}, who is either not in the table or not in the target's audience. Fix the caller, or add that person to the table or to the audience.

unknown_target.message: There is no target {target} in the routing table.

acknowledge_not_allowed.message: The target {target} cannot be acknowledged: it has no alert, or acknowledgement is disabled for it.

snooze_minutes_not_offered.message: The target {target} does not offer a {minutes} min snooze. It offers: {offered}.

unknown_person.message: {person} is not in the Notify Switchboard table.

person_not_in_audience.message: {person} is not in the audience of the target {target}.

invalid_silence_minutes.message: A silence lasts at least one minute; {minutes} is not a duration.

no_audience.message: The target {target} has nobody in its audience.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Turns off the alert linked to a routing-table row, exactly as the Acknowledge button of a notification does.

target.name: Target
target.description: The slug of the routing-table row. Its row must have an alert and allow acknowledgement.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Stops notifications from one target for a while, for one person or for the whole audience of the row.

target.name: Target
target.description: The slug of the routing-table row to snooze.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to snooze. It has to be one of the durations the row offers.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who to snooze it for. Leave empty to snooze everybody in the row's audience.

unsnooze.name: Cancel a snooze
unsnooze.description: Lifts a snooze immediately instead of waiting for it to expire.

target.name: Target
target.description: The slug of the routing-table row to stop snoozing.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose snooze to lift. Leave empty for everybody in the row's audience.

silence.name: Silence a person
silence.description: Silences somebody for a while, for every target. Their own silence entities are left untouched; only a critical message still gets through.

person.name: Person
person.description: The person to silence. They have to be in the Notify Switchboard table.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the silence lasts, at least one minute.

unsilence.name: Lift a silence
unsilence.description: Lifts a silence set by the silence service immediately. Does nothing if the person is not silenced that way.

person.name: Person
person.description: The person whose silence to lift.
